Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study uses both DDA and PRM. DDA was used for discovery/identification and AP-MS, while PRM was used for targeted validation of the novel protein GT3-INCP. The primary workflow for the AP-MS data is routed to mod_ap_ms.

scope: The ectopically expressed FLAG-tagged and endogenously expressed GT3-INCP immunoprecipitated with an anti-FLAG/anti–GT3-INCP antibody were resolved in NuPAGE 10% Bis-Tris gels
we performed affinity purification using an anti-FLAG antibody followed by MS (AP-MS) in MCF7 cells that stably expressed FLAG-tagged GT3-INCP or FLAG-tagged GFP
The whole-cell lysates were incubated with anti-FLAG M2 agarose beads (Sigma-Aldrich, A2220) overnight with gentle rotation at 4°C.

The precipitated proteins on the beads were eluted by competition with 3×FLAG peptides (Sigma-Aldrich, F4799). The eluted proteins were resolved in SDS-PAGE and were sent to the Taplin MS facility (https://taplin.hms.harvard.edu/home) for LC-MS/MS analysis

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiments involved both immunoprecipitation of a specific protein (GT3-INCP) and AP-MS to map interacting proteins, both of which constitute affinity-purified material rather than whole cell lysate.
